final: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM patient_ratios), above_overall AS (SELECT p.ratio, o.overall_avg FROM patient_ratios AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS group_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(a.ratio - a.overall_avg) AS average_above_overall, AVG(a.ratio - g.group_avg) AS average_above_group FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE a.ratio > g.group_avg
